lead_raw_text:
The MgMn structure (Mg6Mn6, 12 atoms per cell) crystallizes in the trigonal space group R-3 (No. 143), with two independent Wyckoff orbits and two unit-cell components. Geometry-derived analysis shows Mg and Mn centers each with 12 geometric neighbors (6 Mg, 6 Mn), and the periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3-dimensional component spanning all 12 sites. Validated polyhedron contacts reveal corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among 12-vertex Mg and Mn coordination polyhedra, though these do not assert an exclusive sharing type for all polyhedra.
